start:
SQUAD — find your CS2 teammates.

Start by confirming your age and the community rules in the Mini App, setting a Telegram username and connecting Steam. Contact details are shared only after a request is accepted.
rules: SQUAD rules: participation is for ages {age} and up. Age and rules confirmation are required. Respect other players: no harassment, threats, spam, cheating or fake profiles. Do not put contacts in profiles or invitations. Report a player from their card or a request; blocking is a separate action. A report does not guarantee a specific outcome.
privacy: SQUAD stores your Telegram ID and username for login/contact, age and rules confirmation, CS2 profile, linked Steam/FACEIT and cached game stats, privacy settings, requests, blocks and reports. We do not request your birth date or Steam/FACEIT passwords. The feed shows profile fields and badges; CS2 hours appear only with sharing enabled. Account identifiers and your library are not public. Sending a request expresses the sender's consent; after the recipient accepts, both participants can obtain each other's freshly checked Telegram contact. Contacts do not appear in feed/request lists. Moderators see reports and can explicitly request a contact. In the Mini App you can change privacy, report/block someone or delete your account with confirmation. Reports about deleted accounts are anonymized for moderation; administrator audit records survive without the deleted user link. Resolved reports are kept for up to {retention} days and requests ended without acceptance for up to 90 days. Telegram messages already received cannot be recalled.
help: Open the Mini App with /start. Confirm your age/rules, set a Telegram username, link Steam and publish a complete profile. Send requests in the feed; contacts become available after acceptance. Use Report on a player or request. Your profile contains blocked players, privacy and confirmed account deletion. /rules shows community rules, /privacy explains data and rights. Support: {support}
supportFallback: support contact is not configured yet
banNotice: Access has been restricted. If this is a mistake, contact: {support}
banNoticeNoSupport: Access has been restricted. If this is a mistake, contact your community administrator.

admin.help:
SQUAD administration
/reports — open reports
/report <id> — report detail
/user <id> — user status
/ban <id> <reason> — restrict access, confirmation required
/unban <id> — restore access, confirmation required
/hide <id> — hide profiles
/unhide <id> — restore validated previously published profiles
/dismiss <report id> [note] — dismiss report
/action <report id> [note] — record action taken (does not ban automatically)
/stats — aggregate counts
IDs are internal UUIDs. Confirmations expire after five minutes and are single-use. Contacts require a separate button.
admin.invalid: Unable to perform this command. Check /admin for the format.
admin.confirmationExpired: Confirmation is unavailable, expired or already used. Repeat the command.
admin.cannotRestore: Cannot restore this profile. Check restrictions, consent, Steam and profile completeness.
admin.rateLimited: Too many commands. Please wait a minute.
admin.banDone: Access restricted. Profiles hidden, pending requests canceled and sessions revoked.
admin.unbanDone: Access restored. Profiles remain hidden until a separate review and /unhide.
admin.hideDone: Profiles hidden and flagged for review.
admin.unhideDone: Validation passed. Previously published profiles restored.
admin.evidenceHidden: Details contain contact data and are hidden.
